entry.label: Self-organisation
entry.description: The development of global order or coordination through local interactions without an external central controller specifying the resulting pattern. Boundaries, constraints, energy and environment still matter.
entry.canonical_definition: A process in which interactions among components generate or maintain an organised macro-pattern without a central external controller prescribing that pattern; the system boundary, local rules, constraints and environment must be specified.

profile.title: Self-organisation
profile.canonical_definition: A process in which interactions among components generate or maintain an organised macro-pattern without a central external controller prescribing that pattern; the system boundary, local rules, constraints and environment must be specified.
profile.summary: Self-organisation describes organised macro-patterns arising through interactions among components rather than being prescribed by an external central controller. The system still depends on boundaries, local rules, resources, constraints and an environment.
profile.why_it_matters: The phrase is often instrumentalised as if leaders can order emergence or simply withdraw. A useful account specifies the local interactions, constraints and selection processes that generate the pattern, and asks who drew the system boundary.
key_distinctions: no central prescription vs no causes or constraints
description by an observer vs intrinsic organisation
historical_lineage: von Foerster 1960: systems and environments, order from noise
later complexity science: local interaction and global pattern
practice_connections: specify what interactions are being enabled or blocked
look for power embedded in rules and resources
do not treat leaderless as ungoverned
intervene in conditions rather than promise a designed outcome
common_misreadings: the system organises itself towards good ends
profile.editorial_note: Readable orientation and evidence-backed first pass. Not accepted scholarly consensus until named review is recorded.
